title: Realistic 3D Red Apple
teaches: Show one 3D apple mesh in textured, gray wireframe and white clay stages.
Generate the apple from a shared profile, seeded shape noise and radial lobes; derive wireframe and breakaway pieces from its geometry without repeating vertices.
Couple apple roll rotation to silhouette-based floor contact and travel distance.
Move the camera past a close peel view, look away briefly, and return to the opening composition for a loop.
Author camera-owned depth of field shared by WGPU and Weaver, keeping clay/wire shots sharp and animating surface focus for the macro loop.
Sync an original synthesized music cue and foley to the apple material changes, breakaway, camera pass, and final roll.
